items.title: Your guide to Retail and Consumer Goods at re:Invent 2026
items.summary: AI is reshaping how retail and consumer goods teams work and how shoppers discover and buy products. Here's your guide to the Retail and Consumer Goods sessions, keynotes, customer experiences, and events at AWS re:Invent 2026 in Las Vegas, November 30 to December 4.
items.creator: Gabrielle Russillo
